# UI/Render

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [ClipMask.h](ClipMask.h): A second coverage mask everything drawn under it is multiplied by. (declares `ClipMask`, `sameClipMask`)
- [ClipShader.h](ClipShader.h): How much of the clip reaches a fragment, written once for both shape renderers -- the same arrangement GradientShader is, and for the same reason: a quad and a triangle differ in how a fragment is reached and not at all in what it then does. (declares `clipCoverage`, `packClipMask`)
- [ContentHash.h](ContentHash.h): FNV-1a over whatever a cached thing is made of, which is how everything in this tier that is worth keeping is keyed: a gradient by its stops, a path by its points. (declares `ContentHash`)
- [CoverageAtlas.h](CoverageAtlas.h): One texture every path in the interface rasterizes into, so that drawing a path costs a quad rather than a texture bind and a batch break. (declares `CoverageAtlas`)
- [DrawList.h](DrawList.h): The shadow a rounded box casts, in the terms it is authored in: the box that casts it, how far it falls, how far past that box it spreads, how wide its blur is, and whether it falls inside the box rather than behind it. (declares `ShadowShape`, `ShapeDraw`, `GlyphRun`, `MeshDraw`, `LayerDraw`, `ImageDraw`, `ClipDraw`, `DrawCommand`, `DrawList`)
- [DrawPlayer.h](DrawPlayer.h): Draws recorded lists into a pass. (declares `DrawPlayer`)
- [Gradient.h](Gradient.h): How a gradient carries on past the two ends of its own ramp. (declares `GradientSpread`, `Gradient`, `GradientFill`)
- [GradientRamps.h](GradientRamps.h): One texture holding every gradient the interface draws, a row of colours apiece, so that a gradient-filled shape costs a fetch rather than a pipeline. (declares `GradientRamps`)
- [GradientShader.h](GradientShader.h): The gradient the two shape renderers both evaluate, written once. (declares `gradientFill`, `packGradient`)
- [ImageBatch.h](ImageBatch.h): One image. (declares `ImageInstance`, `ImageBatch`)
- [ImageCache.h](ImageCache.h): Turns a decoded image into a texture once, however many components draw it. (declares `ImageCache`)
- [ImageTexture.h](ImageTexture.h): A decoded image on the GPU: its texture, with the chain of smaller levels a picture drawn below its own size samples from, and the size it came in at. (declares `ImageTexture`, `ImageRef`)
- [Layer.h](Layer.h): A run of drawing rendered into a texture of its own, so it can be composited as one thing rather than a shape at a time. (declares `Layer`)
- [LayerRenderer.h](LayerRenderer.h): A layer's texture drawn back into the pass, faded by its opacity. (declares `LayerRenderer`)
- [MaskCache.h](MaskCache.h): Coverage already rasterized, keyed by the geometry that produced it, so that two components drawing the same shape hold one slot between them instead of two copies of the same texels. (declares `MaskCache`)
- [MeshBatch.h](MeshBatch.h): One triangle of a filled shape. (declares `MeshTriangle`, `MeshBatch`)
- [PathShape.h](PathShape.h): A vector shape a component draws: the path, the coverage a kernel rasterized for it, and the slot of the shared atlas that coverage lives in. (declares `PathShape`)
- [ShapeBatch.h](ShapeBatch.h): One shape. (declares `ShapeInstance`, `ShapeBatch`)

<!-- agent-docs:end -->
